item.title: ‘Judicial decisions are not political statements,’ Wyoming chief justice says following abortion ruling criticism
item.description: by Maggie Mullen, WyoFile CHEYENNE—After the Wyoming Supreme Court ruled last month that the state’s two abortion bans are unconstitutional, Republican lawmakers did not hesitate to cast aspersions at the judiciary branch.
